# NetBox source-of-truth automation lab
__meta__:
  deployer:
    type: agnosticd
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: v2.12.0
  catalog:
    display_name: NetBox Automation Lab
    category: Workshops

cloud_provider: none
config: openshift-workloads
workloads:
- ocp4_workload_netbox_ipam

# Attendees import about 45 GiB of device and IPAM history in module 2.
ocp4_workload_netbox_ipam_db_storage_gi: 60
ocp4_workload_netbox_ipam_superuser: admin

---
become_override: false
ocp_username: opentlc-mgr
silent: false

ocp4_workload_netbox_ipam_namespace: netbox
ocp4_workload_netbox_ipam_version: "4.1.6"
ocp4_workload_netbox_ipam_superuser: admin

# PostgreSQL volume, as a Kubernetes quantity.
# v2.12.0: replaces ocp4_workload_netbox_ipam_db_storage_gi, which is removed
# and no longer read.
ocp4_workload_netbox_ipam_db_storage_size: 10Gi
ocp4_workload_netbox_ipam_redis_storage_size: 2Gi
